L05: the ṭā' of القطب printed broken (Tesseract reads القعاب).

L12: واللّٰه: the shadda and the superscript alif over the second lām, as everywhere in this print.
L15: وست has no shadda (the marks over it are the tā''s dots).
L19: the dot of the nūn of نقطة printed as a thin fragment (1.4 x 1.1 pt) at the height of the dots, not a damma.
L20: الشِّتَويّ: a shadda over the shīn with a kasra under it, a fatha over the tā', a shadda over the yā'.
